title: Project Analysis tool manifest
description: Machine-readable, target-neutral inventory of the analyzer toolchain. Single source read by the doctor, setup, and compatibility surfaces. Describes tools and their contracts only; it records no analyzed-project data.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file (editor/tooling convenience).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this manifest's shape.

ownership.description: analyzer-managed = installed by `setup` into the data root; developer-managed = a prerequisite the developer provides (never installed by the skill).

requirement.description: required = analysis cannot run without it; optional = its absence yields disclosed reduced coverage.

lanes.description: Analysis lanes this tool serves. Used to decide applicability for a target.

executable.description: Command probed on PATH, or null for a library/package with no standalone binary.

version_probe.description: Command that prints the installed version (for doctor/drift), or null.

validated_version.description: The version validated by the project, or null when unpinned.

accepted_range.description: Human-readable accepted version range, or null.

pinned.description: True when the version is pinned (lockfile or exact install), false when only validated/recorded.

network_host.description: Host contacted at install-time (analyzer-managed) or at analysis-time (network lane), or null for fully offline tools.

runtime_contract.description: True when this tool's version participates in the runtime-contract identity used by the compatibility check (analyzer-owned pinned tools + the core interpreter); false when its version is only recorded per-run.

reconcile.description: How setup reconciles this tool on install/upgrade: rebuild (regenerate the artifact), reinstall (replace the package), probe-only (developer-managed; detect and report), not-applicable.
